'''''Euphorbia azorica''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the spurge family [[Euphorbiaceae]], endemic to the [[Azores]], [[Portugal]].<ref name =POWO>{{Cite web | title=Euphorbia azorica Hochst. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:345714-1|access-date=2021-04-28|website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref>

It is found in coastal rocks and sands and wastelands of the coast. It is present in all of the nine Azorean islands.<ref>{{cite web |title=Euphorbia azorica Seub. |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1Euphorbia+azorica |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=24 March 2021}}</ref><ref name=COL>{{cite web |title=Euphorbia azorica Hochst. |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/3CMY9 |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=24 March 2021}}</ref>
